page.overview:
Who is Altradler?

is a giant eagle using the aerie in the city of Riesingürtle as his home. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Altradler is a massive and very old 30-foot-tall giant eagle with white plumage that darkens to a soft gray around the edge of his beak and around the socks of his leg plumage near his talons. He has an old healed injury over one eye that remains "a little bit weepy."

Altradler has flown across the skies of Helvar for four decades.

Altradler was awakened in the middle of the night to carry the Seekers from Riesingürtle to Castle Torch. When Thaisha Lloy cast Speak with Animals on him, she promised him a cow if he would transport the party to Gerwyn. Altradler was worried about being so near the darkness that he knew was near the city, and promised to fly slow so they wouldn't land in the dark. The party boarded the wooden carriage placed on his back, and rested during the flight. In the morning, they awakened to find Altradler circling the city, and at their request he landed them safely. Instead of the promised cow, there were many goats that he promptly began eating, and Thaisha sought out their owner and reimbursed him. Altradler then headed back to his home in Riesingürtle.
